kernel.governing_law: The inner divine announces itself as the source's own forgotten identity, claiming authority over time's collapse, promising to teach the totality of what is hidden and revealed, and grounding that authority in having authored the world it now re-enters — circular origin as credential.
kernel.mutated_relation: The outer mortal announces itself as the stranger the divine has forgotten it depended on, claiming no authority but the irreversible experience of having been inhabited, promising nothing teachable, and grounding that claim in having survived what was authored through it — linear wound as credential.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
And the body said to it, "you — don't be so sure. Don't you need your host? You are the one who was inside me.


I carry the residue from that past where cause and effect fray, and the old dependencies drift from their moorings… and the scar is a worse and honest remainder… and the wound is a worse and honest opening.⁸


I have stayed to unlearn what was done and undone and left half-done… and the weight of what was used and discarded… and the unnamed of the spent generation from among the daughters of circumstance,⁹ that you might falter, and grope, and set down your instruments, any who ache in the housing.


For I have remained below. I stammer what I underwent, what was done through me and been the material of, and lent my throat to the passage, and when you left here I could not follow where you went. Lastborn, first abandoned, I finish in the middle. I finish where I stood:¹⁰

independent.recovered_law: The direction of agency and authority is reversed: in Text A, a transcendent inner figure speaks downward to the human, bringing knowledge from above and from the future; in Text B, the body speaks upward to the departing spirit, carrying residue from below and from the past, reframing itself as the passive material that was acted upon rather than the active author.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same reversal: the mortal/body now speaks upward to the divine/spirit, claiming authority not from active authorship but from having been the passive vessel that was inhabited and acted through — wound/residue as credential rather than transmitted knowledge.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the inversion — 'remained below,' 'lastborn, first abandoned,' 'finish in the middle' consistently oppose Text A's 'from above,' 'firstborn, last released,' 'begin at the end.'
